'''Melissa''' (Japanese: '''ヨシキ''' ''Yoshiki'', a male in the Japanese version) is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP077|The Fourth Round Rumble]]''.

Melissa {{pkmn|battle}}d {{Gary}} during the fourth round of the [[Indigo Plateau Conference]]. Melissa was shown to be a quite powerful {{pkmn|Trainer}}. As only one Pokémon remained in each Trainer's team, Melissa's {{p|Golem}} defeated Gary's {{p|Nidoking}}, sending the [[Pallet Town]] resident home. Melissa was not seen afterwards.

Melissa is male in the Japanese version, and female in the English version.
